snippet.title: TOP STEED is in Early Access Now!
snippet.description:
TOP STEED is in Early Access Now! Get it on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4362880/TOP_STEED/

Drift your horse through tight turns and secure your spot as the top steed. Play against your friends in online or split-screen multiplayer, or hone your skills in single-player across five tracks in three iconic locations.

The Early Access release includes:
- 5 tracks across 3 distinct locations
- Single-player
- Local multiplayer (up to 4 players in split-screen)
- Online multiplayer (up to 10 players)
- Time attack
- Tutorial arena
- Horse & rider customization
- Player progression unlocking additional customization options
- Photo Mode

#IndieGame #HorseGame #ArcadeRacing #GameRelease #EarlyAccess
